tweets.text:
First English as a programming language, then vibe coding, now Software 3.0. 

Andrej Karpathy keeps giving us new ways to see AI evolution.

Software isn’t just “eating the world” anymore. We're watching software eat the software that eats software—an infinite recursion that's just getting started.

From handcrafted code (1.0) to learned systems (2.0) to generative AI (3.0), each layer abstracts and consumes the one below it. The question isn't whether this will continue—it's how quickly we can adapt to riding the wave.
